about_short_description.short_description: Soren is a manufacturing company that designs and manufactures automatic systems for the food industry processing sector.

product.name: Ice Cream Preparation Systems
product.description: Systems designed for the automated preparation of ice cream mix, including storage, dosing, mixing, pasteurization, aging, and freezing.

product.name: Continuous Freezers
product.description: Freezers designed for continuous ice cream production with capacities ranging from 20 to 2300 liters per hour, featuring different dasher types for various ice cream textures.

product.name: Scraped Surface Heat Exchangers (SSHE)
product.description: Heat exchangers for heating, cooling, crystallizing, pasteurizing, and sterilizing viscous or particulate food products.

product.name: Mixing Tanks Model ASA
product.description: Mixing tanks designed to create homogeneous mixes with high powder concentrations using a high-speed impeller and square section design.

product.name: Buffer Tanks
product.description: Tanks used to pre-heat and store food mixes, working alternately to maintain continuous production flow.

product.name: CIP (Clean-In-Place) Systems
product.description: Automated cleaning systems for food processing equipment that manage detergent cycles, rinsing, and solution recycling.
